install:
sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3.12-venv > /dev/null 2>&1; python3.12 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && { grep -q 'VIRTUAL_ENV=.*\.venv' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || printf '
# Auto-activate PHINS venv
export VIRTUAL_ENV="%s/.venv"
export PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"
' "$PWD" >> ~/.bashrc; }
